method.basis_selection: PCA top 3 or rank-three C0-whitened C1 eigenvectors, fit exclusively on other three chains
method.validation: each held-out seed examined individually; no held-out data enter basis selection
method.connected: global vacuum subtraction on held-out gauge configurations, with periodic timeslice averaging
method.uncertainty: circular moving-block bootstrap within held-out chain; block lengths 10,20,40,80; 320 resamples
method.scope: not a physical glueball mass fit, nor independent cross-fold ensemble estimates
